metadata.decoded_reference_layout: For matching records: payload = bbox(8) + class(1) + scale(1) + flag(1) + referenceCount(1) + references(4 each) + trailing(1).
metadata.geometry_assumption: GeoJSON geometry assumes local Y=0 is the projected southern edge of the tile.
metadata.alternative_orientation: Each feature property bbox_if_y_origin_is_north provides the alternative if Y=0 is the northern edge.
metadata.warning: These are candidate record bounds, not decoded chart geometries or verified navigation objects.
